# The Bluecap Mother

*A blue mushroom as big as a house has made the Bluecap Hollow her own, and her brood fills the Deepwood. Watch the ground: the red marks show where her pale threads will burst and where she will land. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [Bluecap Mother](../monsters/bluecap_mother.md) |
| Arena | [The Bluecap Hollow](../maps/bluecap_hollow.md) |

- Unlocked by [The Bluecap Mother](../quests/the_bluecap_mother.md)
- Entered by talking to [Hale](../npcs/hale.md)
